recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered studio portrait of a man with a warm sepia-toned color grade, featuring a distinctive vertical elliptical graphic on the right side containing serif text and a red script title across the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical ellipse acts as a secondary anchor to the centered face.
The red script provides a sharp color contrast against the monochromatic sepia palette.
The tight cropping emphasizes the subject's gaze and facial features.
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary name text
High-contrast red script for the secondary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, filling the majority of the frame from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the vertical tan ellipse on the right third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the vertical name on the right, then down to the red script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is a soft-focus studio wall with subtle vertical texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the facial highlights and deep shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is uppercase, high-contrast serif with vertical stacking
Secondary text is a fluid, connected cursive script with long swashes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' and 'L' in the script have extended decorative tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, vertical serif with a fluid, horizontal script.
graphicDevices: Vertical tan ellipse with soft edges

avoid: Horizontal orientation for the primary name

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast serifs match the elegant vertical text
Matches the formal, flowing nature of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight studio portrait of a man with a mustache, looking directly at the camera. Apply a warm, golden-sepia filter. The background should be a textured, out-of-focus studio wall. Include a vertical tan ellipse on the right side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white uppercase serif text vertically inside the ellipse. Add a red calligraphic script title across the bottom, overlapping the subject's chest.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text stacked vertically?
Is the bottom script vibrant red?
Is the overall tone warm and sepia-based?
Is the portrait centered and tight?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red script is legible against the dark clothing.
Check that the vertical text is perfectly centered within the ellipse.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the skin and background.
Confirm the subject's eyes are the sharpest point of focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered studio portrait + warm sepia grade + vertical elliptical graphic with serif text + horizontal red script footer.
